title: RubricAtlas: Mining Type-Level Rubrics from Expert Reports to Evaluate Deep Research Agents
title_zh: RubricAtlas：从专家报告中挖掘类型级评分标准以评估深度研究智能体

paragraphs.en: Deep research agents conduct multi-step Web searches and synthesise retrieved information into analytical reports. Evaluating these outputs requires checking which analyses they deliver, beyond the presence of relevant facts. Query-specific binary rubrics make individual requirements explicit, but task-level checklists may leave the overall analytical structure underexamined. We introduce RubricAtlas, which derives type-level analytical requirements from expert reports on different objects within the same research type and organises detailed checks around recurring analytical questions. The requirements give related tasks a shared standard for what to analyse, without prescribing their answers. Our framework links binary checkpoints to report passages and evaluates completeness separately from argument validity. Built from 3,079 Chinese financial research reports, RubricAtlas covers 99 research types. Reference-report selection experiments show that individual reports cover only about half of their type’s analytical questions, and that selecting requirements from different reports changes evaluation scores and agent rankings. Across ten agents, two judge pipelines achieve checkpoint agreement of κ \kappa = 0.71 and agent-ranking agreement of Kendall τ \tau = 0.87. Controlled deletions reduce scores on the affected analyses, while padding produces no detectable increase. These findings support type-level rubrics for comparing the analytical completeness of Web deep research outputs, with individual decisions traceable to report evidence.

paragraphs.en: Deep research agents carry out multi-step Web searches, read retrieved pages and synthesise findings into analytical reports ( Nakano et al., 2021 ; Du et al., 2025 ; Gou et al., 2025 ) . Including relevant facts is not the same as completing the relevant analysis.

paragraphs.en: A common approach to evaluating deep research outputs is to use query-specific binary rubrics : requirements written for an individual task and judged one by one as met or unmet ( Sharma et al., 2025 ; Akyürek et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . These rubrics make individual requirements explicit. However, an evaluation centred on checklist items can foreground task-specific details while leaving the report’s overall analytical structure underexamined. The issue is not whether decisions are binary, but whether they reveal which analyses the details collectively support and which remain incomplete. We therefore organise evaluation around analytical questions, with detailed checks specifying what each analysis should deliver. To ground this organisation beyond the choices made for one query or reference report, we derive recurring requirements from expert reports on different research objects.
paragraphs.zh: 评估深度研究（deep research）输出的一种常用方法是使用针对具体查询的二元评分标准：即为单个任务编写若干要求，并逐条判定其是否满足（Sharma et al., 2025；Akyürek et al., 2025；Li et al., 2026）。 这些评分标准使单个要求变得明确。 然而，以清单条目为中心的评估可能会突出任务特定的细节，而使报告的整体分析结构得不到充分审视。 问题不在于这些判定是否为二元判定，而在于它们能否揭示哪些分析得到了这些细节的 collectively 支持、哪些分析仍不完整。 因此，我们围绕分析问题来组织评估，由细节检查明确每项分析应当交付的内容。 为了使这种组织方式超越针对单个查询或参考报告所做的选择，我们从针对不同研究对象的专家报告中推导出反复出现的要求。

paragraphs.en: Expert reports provide examples of how professionals analyse different objects. We define a research type as a research-question family within an industry, such as studies of oil and gas producers’ operations and value realisation. Within a type, reports may attribute advantages to different resources or distribution networks, but repeatedly ask: which verifiable capabilities distinguish the firm from its peers, and under what conditions can that advantage persist? By combining these reports, we identify recurring requirements: name the capability, compare it with named peers using comparable metrics, and examine what could sustain or erode the advantage. These requirements describe what to analyse, not what to conclude. They reflect the source reports’ professional practice, rather than a universal checklist for every request.
paragraphs.zh: 专家报告提供了专业人士如何分析不同对象的示例。 我们将研究类型定义为某一行业内的研究问题族，例如对油气生产商的运营与价值实现的研究。 在同一类型内，报告可能将优势归因于不同的资源或分销网络，但会反复追问：哪些可验证的能力将该企业与同行区分开来，以及在何种条件下该优势能够持续？ 通过结合这些报告，我们识别出反复出现的要求：说出该能力的名称，使用可比较的指标与指名的同行进行比较，并考察哪些因素可能维持或侵蚀该优势。 这些要求描述的是要分析什么，而不是要得出什么结论。 它们反映的是源报告中的专业实践，而非适用于每个请求的通用清单。

paragraphs.en: Our framework combines two designs (Figure 1 ). Type-level induction derives reusable analytical requirements across research objects. A question-centred hierarchy organises their evaluation into questions, required results ( Targets ) and binary checkpoints. For example, a question asks which capabilities give the firm an advantage; one required result is a peer comparison; its checkpoints ask whether the report names peers and provides comparable metrics. The details are thus evaluated as parts of an analysis, not as isolated facts. Passages are assigned to questions, checkpoint decisions cite the corresponding report blocks, and scores are aggregated within the hierarchy. This produces both a report score and a profile of completed and missing analyses. Completeness measures whether the required analytical content is present, not whether its facts or reasoning are correct. Argument validity is assessed separately.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的框架结合了两种设计（图 1）。 类型层面的归纳可以在不同研究对象之间推导出可复用的分析要求。 以问题为中心的层级结构将其评估组织为问题、所需结果（目标）以及二元检查点。 例如，某个问题询问哪些能力能给该企业带来优势；其中一项所需结果是同行比较；其检查点询问报告是否点名了同行并提供了可比的指标。 这样，细节便作为分析的组成部分被评估，而不是作为孤立的事实。 段落被分配到相应的问题，检查点判定会引用对应的报告内容块，分数则在层级结构内进行汇总。 这既产生了一个报告得分，也生成了一份已完成与缺失分析的概貌。 完整性衡量的是所需的分析内容是否存在，而不是其事实或推理是否正确。 论证的有效性则被单独评估。

paragraphs.en: We construct RubricAtlas from 3,079 Chinese financial research reports issued by 64 institutions, yielding 99 research types, 921 questions and 8,160 checkpoints. Our reference-report selection experiments examine how the requirements used to evaluate these outputs depend on the expert reports behind them. We measure the fraction of a type’s questions covered by each report and average within types; the median across types is 54%. Evaluating only questions supported by each task’s source report raises completeness scores by 10.5 points and gives Kendall τ \tau = 0.60 with the full-atlas agent ranking. Thus, selecting one report’s analyses changes both the coverage of the evaluation and its outcomes. These experiments restrict the frozen atlas; they do not reconstruct query-specific rubrics.
paragraphs.zh: 我们基于64家机构发布的3,079份中文金融研究报告构建了RubricAtlas，得到99种研究类型、921个问题和8,160个检查点。 我们的参考报告选择实验考察了用于评估这些输出的要求如何依赖于其背后的专家报告。 我们衡量每种类型的问题被各报告覆盖的比例，并在类型内部取平均；跨类型的中位数为54%。 仅评估每项任务源报告所支持的问题，可使完整性得分提高10.5分，并使与全图谱智能体排序之间的Kendall τ \tau = 0.60。 因此，选择某一报告的分析会同时改变评估的覆盖范围及其结果。 这些实验是对冻结图谱的限制，并不重建针对特定查询的评分标准。

paragraphs.en: Multi-reference methods aggregate content for one input: Pyramid weights units by reference frequency ( Nenkova and Passonneau, 2004 ) , and TREC evaluates vital and okay nuggets ( Voorhees, 2003 ) . We abstract analyses across different objects within a type.
paragraphs.zh: 多参考方法针对单个输入聚合内容：Pyramid 按参考频率为单元赋权（Nenkova and Passonneau, 2004），TREC 则评估 vital 与 okay 级别的要点（Voorhees, 2003）。 要点可以根据评估者之间的一致性赋权（Lin and Demner-Fushman, 2006），或使用大语言模型进行抽取和评估（Mayfield et al., 2024；Pradeep et al., 2025）。 我们对同一类型内不同对象的分析进行了抽象。

paragraphs.en: D2 Organised and reusable. Requirements should be organised around analytical questions, so that individual decisions reveal which analyses are complete or missing. This organisation should be reusable across tasks within a research type. Checklists turn holistic judgments into binary decisions ( Cook et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Wei et al., 2025b ) ; instance-specific evaluators use rubrics or skill sets ( Ye et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2024 ) , and rubrics also serve as rewards ( Gunjal et al., 2025 ; Shao et al., 2025 ) . DEER and FinDeepResearch provide top-down task-level templates ( Han et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) . We retain binary checks but organise them under questions derived bottom-up from expert reports across research objects.
paragraphs.zh: D2 有组织且可复用。 需求应围绕分析性问题来组织，使各个决策能揭示哪些分析已完成、哪些尚缺失。 这种组织方式应可在同一研究类型内的各任务之间复用。 检查清单将整体性判断转化为二元决策（Cook 等，2024；Lee 等，2025；Wei 等，2025b）；针对具体实例的评估器使用评分规则或技能集（Ye 等，2024；Kim 等，2024），评分规则也可用作奖励（Gunjal 等，2025；Shao 等，2025）。 DEER 和 FinDeepResearch 提供自上而下的任务级模板（Han 等，2025；Zhu 等，2025）。 我们保留二元检查，但将它们组织在自下而上从跨研究对象的专家报告中推导出的问题之下。

paragraphs.en: D3 Attributable. Judgments should identify the unmet requirement or supporting evidence. Factuality evaluation decomposes text into atomic claims ( Min et al., 2023 ) ; Mind2Web 2 verifies task-specific rubric trees against cited pages ( Gou et al., 2025 ) , and ReportLogic evaluates reasoning ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . Our checkpoints cite report blocks retrieved verbatim by the program, not reconstructed by the judge.
paragraphs.zh: D3 可归因性。 判断应指出未满足的要求或对应的支撑证据。 事实性评估将文本分解为原子性论断（Min et al., 2023）；Mind2Web 2 针对被引用页面验证任务特定的评估准则树（Gou et al., 2025），而 ReportLogic 则对推理进行评估（Zhao et al., 2026）。 我们的检查点引用由程序逐字检索得到的报告片段，而非由评判者重构的内容。

paragraphs.en: D4 Reproducible. Comparisons should remain stable across judges. IR studies examine assessor disagreement, incomplete judgments, topic sampling and metric discrimination ( Voorhees, 2000 ; Zobel, 1998 ; Voorhees and Buckley, 2002 ; Sakai, 2006 ) . Reproducibility differs from measurement validity ( Jacobs and Wallach, 2021 ) .

paragraphs.en: FinResearchBench ( Sun et al., 2025 ) combines report-level logic-tree metrics with LLM judgments. FinResearchBench II ( Luan et al., 2026 ) generates rubrics from multiple systems’ reports for one query, then filters for judge consistency and distinguishability. Structured evaluation is therefore not unique to our approach: existing methods also use rubric trees, logic trees and templates. Our distinction is how the analytical structure is grounded and reused. Expert reports on different objects supply type-level questions and required results, under which evidence-linked checks are organised. The consensus tier denotes analyses in a majority of source reports, not agreement among judges.
paragraphs.zh: FinResearchBench（Sun et al., 2025）将报告级逻辑树指标与LLM判断相结合。 FinResearchBench II（Luan et al., 2026）针对同一查询从多个系统的报告中生成评分细则，再根据评委一致性与区分度进行筛选。 因此，结构化评估并非我们方法的独有之处：现有方法同样使用评分细则树、逻辑树和模板。 我们的区别在于分析结构如何被落地和复用。 针对不同对象撰写的专家报告提供了类型层面的问题与所需结果，与证据相关联的核查即在这些问题和结果之下组织展开。 共识层级指的是在多数源报告的分析中出现的结论，而非评委之间的一致。

paragraphs.en: Analytical requirements. The rubric is a tree: dimension → \to question → \to required result → \to checkpoint . Questions identify analyses, required results specify their expected outputs, and checkpoints assess the content needed to deliver those outputs. Each checkpoint decision therefore remains attached to an analytical requirement. A canonical question represents an analysis found in the type’s reports. Its support records the reports and institutions addressing it; its tier is consensus if a majority of reports address it and differentiating otherwise. A required result (Target) specifies what an answer must deliver without naming a company or date. Binary checkpoints state acceptance and non-acceptance conditions. A Target may have a negative criterion identifying a substitute that misses the intended analysis, such as industry averages instead of named-peer comparisons. Requirements are constructed once per type, not per task.

paragraphs.en: Evidence alignment and completeness. The judge selects passage IDs; the program retrieves original text, preventing insertion of new material. Target evaluation checks content in these passages, citing blocks for yes and explaining no . Missed evidence during alignment can lower scores. Factual and inferential correctness are not assessed; Target requirements provide context, not extra scoring criteria.

paragraphs.en: In the current implementation, a Target’s completeness is its checkpoint pass rate; a triggered negative criterion sets it to 0. Question completeness T (0–1) is the mean of its Targets. Report completeness T (0–100) is the weighted mean of question completeness (differentiating 20, consensus 10) × 100 \times 100 . Averaging within Targets and questions prevents extra checkpoints from increasing an analysis’s report-level weight. Differentiating questions were model-screened and author-verified for analytical depth. The higher weight emphasises this depth and was fixed before examining agent evaluation results; alternatives appear in § 7 . Question, Target and checkpoint profiles locate incomplete analyses alongside report scores.

paragraphs.en: A worked example. Figure 1 illustrates a consensus question for oil and gas producers: which verifiable capabilities give the firm an advantage over comparable firms, and can that advantage persist? It is supported by 14 of 21 reports from 13 institutions, each on a different firm. Source questions concern a gas block’s resource advantage or a sales network’s contribution to stability. Its 3 Targets and 9 checkpoints require capabilities with checkable metrics, named-peer comparisons on like-for-like metrics, and conditions sustaining or eroding the advantage. The second Target’s negative criterion excludes industry averages in place of named peers. A report can thus receive credit for naming a capability but not for a peer comparison it never makes. Providing capability metrics does not substitute for comparing peers or examining persistence conditions: the separate Targets preserve these omissions within the same analytical question.
paragraphs.zh: 一个实例演示。 图 1 展示了一个针对石油天然气生产商的共识性问题：哪些可验证的能力使该公司优于同类公司，以及这种优势能否持续？ 该问题得到来自 13 家机构的 21 份报告中的 14 份的支持，每份报告针对一家不同的公司。 来源层面的问题涉及某个天然气区块的资源优势，或销售网络对稳定性的贡献。 它的 3 个目标和 9 个检查点要求能力具备可核查的指标、在同类指标上与点名同行进行比较，以及维持或侵蚀该优势的条件。 第二个目标的否定性标准排除了用行业平均值替代点名同行的做法。 因此，一份报告可以因点名某项能力而得分，但不能因它从未进行过的同行比较而得分。 提供能力指标并不能替代比较同行或考察持续性条件：各独立的目标将这些遗漏保留在同一个分析性问题之内。

paragraphs.en: Question alignment. Within each type, an LLM maps source questions to canonical questions, background or out-of-scope content; a second LLM checks the mappings. Records preserve supporting reports and source questions. Questions below 3 supporting reports are removed unless judged to have distinct analytic value.

paragraphs.en: Targets and checkpoints. For each canonical question, answering passages are decomposed into data used → \to reasoning → \to conclusion , abstracted into company- and date-independent Targets, and divided into checkpoints. We add negative criteria for plausible substitutes. Before scoring, an AI reviewer checked each criterion for one verifiable requirement, clear wording and no adjacent redundancy ( Akyürek et al., 2025 ) ; authors reviewed all flagged items. Scores use this frozen atlas, unchanged by the later author audit.
paragraphs.zh: 目标与检查点。 对于每个规范问题，我们将回答段落分解为所使用的数据 → \to 推理 → \to 结论，抽象为与公司和日期无关的目标（Targets），并划分为检查点（checkpoints）。 我们为貌似合理的替代项添加了负面标准。 在评分之前，一名 AI 审查员检查了每条标准是否满足单一可验证要求、措辞清晰且无相邻冗余（Akyürek et al., 2025）；作者审查了所有被标记的项目。 分数使用这个冻结的标准图谱，不受后续作者审计的影响而改变。

paragraphs.en: Applicability screening. The workflow excludes requirements outside the industry and research-question family, and those specific to an individual object. It also checks consistency between retained requirements and the requests’ analytical scope. These filters produce type-level standards rather than report-content unions. Requirements are frozen before scoring; request checks match tasks to these standards without regenerating rubrics or adapting them to agent outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 适用性筛选。 该工作流排除行业与研究问题族之外的需求，以及针对单个具体对象的需求。 它还检查保留的需求与请求的分析范围之间的一致性。 这些筛选产生的是类型级标准，而非报告内容合集。 需求在评分前被冻结；请求检查将任务与这些标准相匹配，而不重新生成评分细则，也不根据智能体的输出对评分细则进行调整。

paragraphs.en: Resource contents and access. The resource includes trees with provenance, rules, tasks, prompts, checkpoint judgments, scoring and analysis code, and a datasheet ( Gebru et al., 2021 ) . The materials will be made publicly available after the review process. Re-scoring uses judgments and code; independent re-judging and source verification also need report text and source materials. A verbatim-overlap check sampled 800 criteria, extracted 3,881 spans of 20 normalised characters and searched 3,228 source texts: no matches, with a positive control detected.
paragraphs.zh: 资源内容与获取方式。 该资源包括带来源信息的树结构、规则、任务、提示词、检查点判断、评分与分析代码，以及一份数据表（Gebru et al., 2021）。 这些材料将在评审过程结束后公开发布。 重新评分需要用到判断结果和代码；独立的重新判断与来源核查还需要报告文本和原始材料。 逐字重合检查抽取了 800 项标准，提取了 3,881 个长度为 20 个规范化字符的片段，并在 3,228 个原始文本中进行了检索：未发现匹配项，且阳性对照被成功检出。

paragraphs.en: Agents and harness. The ten LLMs in Table 4 run as deep research agents in a fixed ReAct harness ( Yao et al., 2023 ) . WebSearch returns Google results via Serper; WebFetch reads pages with Jina and extracts goal-relevant content with gpt-5 . The prompt sets information cutoff 2026-10-09, requires citable sources and prohibits other institutions’ research conclusions as evidence. Each agent runs once per task with provider-default decoding, up to 1,000 turns and 128k output tokens per turn. Tasks and reports are Chinese.

paragraphs.en: Judges and protocol. Judge A is DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; B is GPT-6-luna. Calls use temperature 0 and are grouped by dimension, with decisions assigned to questions. paragraphs.en: We assess two aspects of the approach: which analytical requirements the resource represents, and how consistently evaluation applies them. paragraphs.en: The first author, a finance graduate student, annotated blank forms without AI assistance or access to model judgments: 300 checkpoint decisions and 297 source mappings for 50 canonical questions. paragraphs.en: How does reference selection change requirement coverage and agent comparisons? Using the full atlas as an internal reference, we retain questions supported by selected reports and re-score frozen main-run judgments (§ 5 ). Reports and checkpoint decisions stay fixed; rubrics are not re-extracted (Appendix G ). These comparisons measure reference sensitivity, not which requirements best fit each task.
paragraphs.zh: 参考答案的选择会如何改变需求覆盖度与智能体之间的比较？ 以完整图谱作为内部参考，我们保留被所选报告支持的问题，并对冻结的主运行判定重新打分（§ 5）。 报告与检查点决策保持不变；评分标准不重新提取（附录 G）。 这些比较衡量的是参考答案的敏感性，而非哪些需求最适合每个任务。

paragraphs.en: Coverage. Averaging reports within types, then taking the median across types gives 54% coverage (type means 14–83%); task-source reports cover 57%. The gap is not solely expert disagreement: genre medians are 73% for company coverage and 33% for retrospective reviews; the shortest and longest thirds cover 50% and 63%.
paragraphs.zh: 覆盖率。 先在类型内部对报告取平均，再跨类型取中位数，得到 54% 的覆盖率（类型均值介于 14–83% 之间）；任务来源报告的覆盖率为 57%。 这一差距并非仅源于专家意见分歧：公司报道类文本的覆盖率中位数为 73%，回顾性评论类为 33%；长度最短和最长的三分之一文本覆盖率分别为 50% 和 63%。

paragraphs.en: Removing the measured report from support and dropping questions below 3 reports leaves median coverage at 53%. The other half covers 56% of questions selected from one random half of a pool; the within-half threshold retains more common questions. A single report thus represents only part of a type’s recurring analyses, even excluding its contribution to question selection.
paragraphs.zh: 将实测报告从支持集中移除，并丢弃报告数低于 3 的问题后，中位数覆盖率仍为 53%。 另一半覆盖了从某个池子随机一半中选出的问题的 56%；半内阈值保留了更多常见问题。 因此，即使不计其对问题选择的贡献，单一报告也只能代表某一类型的重复性分析的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Score shifts. Source-supported subsets raise mean completeness by 10.5 points (task-level 95% confidence interval (CI) [7.1, 12.1]), with increases on 77% of tasks. Size-matched random subsets give 1.2 (200 draws; maximum 4.5). Source subsets contain 71% consensus questions, versus 55% overall; consensus scores are higher. Composition matching gives 5.6 (maximum 8.6 across 200 draws), still 4.9 below source subsets, which exceed every matched draw. The remainder is consistent with tasks eliciting source-emphasised analyses, but object-specific applicability is not isolated.
paragraphs.zh: 分数变化。 有来源支持的子集使平均完整性提高10.5分（任务层面95%置信区间（CI）[7.1, 12.1]），在77%的任务上有提升。 尺寸匹配的随机子集仅带来1.2分（200次抽样；最大值4.5）。 来源子集包含71%的共识问题，而总体为55%；共识问题的得分更高。 构成匹配带来5.6分（200次抽样中的最大值为8.6），仍比来源子集低4.9分，来源子集超过了每一次匹配抽样。 其余部分与引出侧重来源分析的任务相一致，但针对特定对象的适用性尚未被分离出来。

paragraphs.en: Ranking sensitivity. Single-report subsets have lower ranking agreement and more leader changes than size-matched random questions (Table 3 ). Task-source subsets give 0.60, versus 0.81 for size-matched subsets and mean 0.74 (5th percentile 0.56) for composition-matched subsets. Size matching alone does not isolate source dependence: composition explains part of the ranking change. Source subsets change the task-level leader on 50% of tasks, versus 45% for size-matched random subsets (Appendix H ). Both reductions affect task-level recommendations, motivating aggregate comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 排序敏感性。 单报告子集比规模匹配的随机问题具有更低的排序一致性和更多的榜首变化（表 3）。 任务来源子集给出 0.60，而规模匹配子集为 0.81，构成匹配子集均值为 0.74（第 5 百分位为 0.56）。 仅进行规模匹配并不能隔离来源依赖性：构成解释了部分排序变化。 来源子集使 50% 的任务改变了任务级榜首，而规模匹配随机子集为 45%（附录 H）。 这两种缩减都会影响任务级推荐，因此有必要进行聚合比较。

paragraphs.en: Aggregation across reports. Three and ten reports cover 79% and 96% of the atlas (Figure 2 ), with ranking correlations 0.79 and 0.95, near size-matched controls (0.89, 0.97). Single-report small pools (10–20) give τ \tau = 0.59 and 45% coverage, but sensitivity is non-monotonic (21–39: 0.79; 40–60: 0.65). About ten reports recover much of the full pool’s coverage and ranking: an internal planning reference, not an external sufficiency threshold.
paragraphs.zh: 跨报告聚合。 三份和十份报告分别覆盖图谱的79%和96%（图2），排序相关性分别为0.79和0.95，接近规模匹配的对照（0.89、0.97）。 单份报告的小样本池（10–20）给出 τ \tau = 0.59 和45%的覆盖率，但敏感性并非单调（21–39：0.79；40–60：0.65）。 约十份报告即可恢复完整报告池的大部分覆盖率和排序：这是一个内部规划参考，而非外部充分性阈值。

paragraphs.en: Removing task-source support drops 14 of 912 questions across 98 common tasks below threshold; re-scoring gives τ \tau = 0.96, with model score changes at most 0.27 points. The aggregate evaluation is therefore not driven by the single report used to construct each task. This supports type-level standards; new-task applicability is discussed in § 8 .
paragraphs.zh: 移除任务来源支持后，912 个问题中有 14 个跨 98 个共同任务的问题低于阈值；重新评分得到 τ \tau = 0.96，模型分数变化最多为 0.27 分。 因此，总体评估并非由用于构建每个任务的单一报告所驱动。 这支持了类型层面的标准；新任务的适用性将在 § 8 中讨论。

paragraphs.en: B independently re-evaluates all 989 reports, including alignment. The 81,469 paired checkpoints agree at 85.4%, with Cohen’s κ \kappa = 0.71 (95% CI [0.70, 0.72], report-clustered) and Jaccard overlap 0.75 for yes decisions. Question-level T correlation is 0.83 over 9,196 questions.

paragraphs.en: B gives fewer yes decisions (48% versus 56%) and scores reports 8.0 points lower on average, but rankings agree at τ \tau = 0.87 (95% CI [0.56, 0.96], task resamples). Both judges have the same first two agents, top-four set and bottom-three order (Table 4 , Figure 3 a). Of A’s 36 pairs separated by over one point, 1 reverses under B; none of 28 separated by over two points reverses. None of B’s 34 pairs separated by over one point reverses under A. Judge choice shifts absolute levels more than clearly separated agents’ ordering. Negative criteria rarely trigger (A 262, B 151 of 25,164); agreement is 99.0% ( κ \kappa = 0.39).
paragraphs.zh: B 给出的“是”判定更少（48% 对 56%），报告平均得分低 8.0 分，但排名一致性达 τ \tau = 0.87（95% CI [0.56, 0.96]，按任务重采样）。 两位评审的前两名智能体、前四名集合和后三名排序相同（表 4，图 3a）。 在 A 评分中分差超过一分的 36 对智能体里，有 1 对在 B 评分下发生反转；分差超过两分的 28 对中没有一对反转。 在 B 评分中分差超过一分的 34 对智能体里，没有一对在 A 评分下发生反转。 评审选择对绝对分数水平的影响大于对分差明显的智能体排序的影响。 负面标准很少触发（25,164 次中 A 触发 262 次，B 触发 151 次）；一致性为 99.0%（κ \kappa = 0.39）。

paragraphs.en: A DeepSeek repeat run on 100 stratified reports (10 tasks × \times ten agents) uses the same model and effort but condensed negative-criterion wording, correlating at 0.96 with the main run. Its standard deviation (SD) proxy is 4.1 points per report and 0.42 for a 98-task mean. Both judges use this estimate, mixing run and wording variation. Alternative settings correlate highly, but nominal high effort need not increase tokens (Appendix D ).
paragraphs.zh: 在 100 份分层报告（10 个任务 × \times 十个智能体）上进行的 DeepSeek 重复运行使用相同的模型和工作量，但采用了精简的负向准则措辞，与主运行的相关系数为 0.96。 其标准差（SD）代理为每份报告 4.1 分，98 个任务均值为 0.42。 两个评判者都使用该估计值，混合了运行与措辞的变异。 替代设置高度相关，但名义上的高工作量未必会增加 token 用量（附录 D）。

paragraphs.en: We perturb 30 reports (ten tasks × \times three agents) and re-evaluate each whole report. Deleting all blocks answering one question lowers its T from 0.64 to 0.21 under A and from 0.57 to 0.19 under B. Median relative reductions are 71% and 83%, with decreases on 20/27 and 22/27 target questions 1 1 1 Perturbation targets were drawn before the atlas was frozen; 27 of the 30 targeted questions are in the resource atlas and are analysed here. . Questions sharing no deleted block change by 0.033 and 0.028 on average, close to unchanged re-evaluation (0.025 and 0.029). The response is concentrated on questions whose content was removed, linking the score change to an identifiable missing analysis rather than only a reduction in report length; Appendix D also reports changes on questions sharing deleted blocks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对30份报告（十个任务 × \times 三个智能体）进行扰动，并重新评估每份完整报告。 删除回答某一问题的所有文本块后，该问题的 T 在 A 下从 0.64 降至 0.21，在 B 下从 0.57 降至 0.19。 相对下降的中位数分别为 71% 和 83%，其中 27 个目标问题中分别有 20/27 和 22/27 出现下降 1 1 1 扰动目标是在图谱冻结之前抽取的；30 个目标问题中有 27 个位于该资源图谱中，本文对这 27 个问题进行分析。。 未共享任何被删除文本块的问题平均变化仅为 0.033 和 0.028，接近未变更的重新评估结果（0.025 和 0.029）。 评分变化集中在内容被移除的问题上，说明分数变化与可识别的缺失分析相关，而不仅仅是报告篇幅缩短所致；附录 D 还报告了共享被删除文本块的问题上的变化。

paragraphs.en: We compare the final reports of Web research agents through completeness totals and analytical tier profiles. We then examine associations with browsing, report length and exposure to source reports. Generic-rule profiles remain separate from completeness.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过完整性总分和分析层级画像对网络研究智能体的最终报告进行比较。 然后我们考察这些结果与浏览行为、报告长度以及源报告接触程度之间的关联。 通用规则画像与完整性保持相互独立。

paragraphs.en: Leading agents and unresolved margins. Claude leads under both judges (92%, 84% first-place resamples), followed by GLM. Ranks 3–7 span 1.5 and 0.8 points, separated from Kimi, Gemini and MiniMax at ranks 8–10 by 5.0 and 3.6 points under A/B.

These profiles summarise coverage of recurring requirements, not the coherence or validity of the agents’ reasoning.

paragraphs.en: Claude makes 53 searches and 50 page reads per report; Gemini makes 13 and 5. Portals and financial media supply 29% of reads, official sources 20%. Within tasks, log searches and reads correlate with T at 0.26 and 0.24 under A, 0.18 and 0.16 under B. Official-source share is weakly associated ( r r = 0.07).

paragraphs.en: With agent/task fixed effects and task-clustered standard errors (SEs), A’s page-read coefficient is 1.2 points per log unit (SE 0.55), versus 1.1 for searches (SE 0.9, not significant). Adding log length gives page coefficient 1.0 (SE 0.54) and length coefficient 8.6 (SE 1.8). B’s page coefficient is 0.3 (SE 0.57, not significant). Browsing evidence is stronger under A; page reads and length correlate at r r = 0.44 within tasks; these observational data do not isolate their contributions.

paragraphs.en: Longer reports score higher: 9.2 points per log length unit under A (SE 1.7), 5.7 under B (SE 1.3). This association does not identify a causal length effect; padding is tested in § 6.4 . Length adjustment leaves Claude first under both judges, with Mimo-V2.6-Pro second under A and GLM under B ( τ \tau = 0.73, 0.87 with main rankings). Length-matched win rates are 52% for Claude and 60% for GLM (Appendix B ); Claude’s lead does not carry over to matching, although it remains first after regression adjustment.
paragraphs.zh: 更长的报告得分更高：在 A 评分标准下每个对数长度单位得 9.2 分（标准误 1.7），在 B 下得 5.7 分（标准误 1.3）。 这种关联并不能确定长度存在因果效应；填充行为在 § 6.4 中进行了检验。 长度调整后，Claude 在两位评判下均保持第一，Mimo-V2.6-Pro 在 A 下位列第二，GLM 在 B 下位列第二（与主排名的 τ \tau 分别为 0.73 和 0.87）。 长度匹配的胜率分别为：Claude 52%，GLM 60% (Appendix B)；Claude 的领先优势并未延续到长度匹配设置中，尽管在回归调整后它仍排名第一。

paragraphs.en: Research-report sites account for 1.7% of 15,798 successful reads and occur in 17% of generated reports’ trajectories. Sell-side content appears in 31% of reports, with scores + + 0.5 points above task means, consistent with browsing associations. Task-source titles appear in search results or pages in 53 of 980 trajectories (5.4%, 95% CI [4.2, 7.0]); exposed reports show no detectable gain ( − - 0.7 points, [ − - 3.5, 2.1]). Source-title exposure is uncommon with no detected benefit. The prompt prohibits other institutions’ conclusions, but its effect is not isolated.
paragraphs.zh: 研究报告类网站占 15,798 次成功读取的 1.7%，并出现在 17% 的已生成报告的轨迹中。 卖方内容出现在 31% 的报告中，得分比任务均值高 0.5 分，与浏览关联一致。 任务来源标题在 980 条轨迹中的 53 条里出现在搜索结果或页面中（5.4%，95% 置信区间 [4.2, 7.0]）；暴露的报告未显示出可检测的增益（−0.7 分，[−3.5, 2.1]）。 来源标题暴露并不常见，且未检测到收益。 提示词禁止使用其他机构的结论，但其效果尚未被单独分离出来。

paragraphs.en: Completeness records delivered analyses, not their validity. General evaluation applies ten argument-flaw rules covering facts, evidence and reasoning (G01–G10; Appendix A ) to aligned material in separate calls (A low, B high effort). It reports claim blocks, basis blocks and reasons per question, without Target requirements, scores or treating missing content as a violation.
paragraphs.zh: 完整性记录所交付的是分析结果，而非其有效性。 通用评估应用十条论证缺陷规则，涵盖事实、证据与推理（G01–G10；附录A），通过分开的调用（A 低努力、B 高努力）对对齐后的材料进行评估。 它报告每个问题的论断块、依据块和理由，不涉及目标（Target）要求、评分，也不将内容缺失视为违规。

paragraphs.en: Agent-level violation profiles. To assess whether aggregation reduces disagreement, we compare each agent’s fraction of questions with any violation, separately from completeness. The intervals overlap, so the point-estimate difference does not establish a ranking-level contrast; the clearer difference is in individual checkpoint and rule agreement ( κ \kappa 0.71 versus median 0.16). Across rules, agent-level τ \tau has median 0.48 and range − - 0.04 (G09) to 0.69 (G03; Table 5 ). paragraphs.en: Interpreting the gap. Checkpoints specify conditions; generic rules leave thresholds such as “overstated” to judges. Binary presence checks differ from multi-label defect detection. Checkpoints pass about half the time; most rules flag fewer than one question in six. A uses medium Target and low General effort, B high for both. These differences are plausible explanations, not separately tested causes.
paragraphs.zh: 解读这一差距。 检查点规定的是条件；一般性规则则将「夸大」等阈值留给评判者判断。 二元存在性检查不同于多标签缺陷检测。 检查点约有半数时间通过；大多数规则在六个问题中标记的不到一个。 A 在 Target 上投入中等努力、在 General 上投入低等努力，B 则两者都投入高等努力。 这些差异是合理的解释，而非经过单独检验的原因。

paragraphs.en: Implications for evaluation. Web research reports need evaluation beyond retrieved facts. Type-level requirements and question-centred checks locate incomplete analyses, preserving profiles behind report scores. These diagnose output content, not whether omissions originate in retrieval or synthesis. Tier profiles locate agent differences on sampled requests. Keeping validity separate prevents conflating missing content with defective reasoning. Absolute scores should identify the judge; relative comparisons are most credible where judges agree.
paragraphs.zh: 对评估的启示。 网络研究报告需要的评估不止于检索到的事实。 类型层面的要求与以问题为中心的检查能定位不完整的分析，保留报告评分背后的特征画像。 这些方法诊断的是输出内容，而非遗漏究竟源于检索还是综合。 层级特征画像能在抽样请求上定位智能体之间的差异。 将效度区分开来，可避免把内容缺失与推理缺陷混为一谈。 绝对分数应注明评判者身份；相对比较在评判者意见一致时最为可信。

paragraphs.en: Scope and transfer. The resource covers Chinese-language financial research (31 industries, 13 question families). Applicability screening and request-scope checks are part of construction, but their accuracy has not been independently quantified. Sampled requests do not establish applicability to every new object. New types need report pools and construction. About ten reports is an internal planning reference, not a transfer guarantee (Table 8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 范围与迁移。 该资源覆盖中文金融研究（31 个行业、13 个问题族）。 适用性筛查与请求范围检查属于构建工作的一部分，但其准确性尚未经过独立量化。 抽样请求并不能确立对每个新对象的适用性。 新类型需要报告池和构建工作。 约 10 份报告只是内部规划参考，并非迁移保证（表 8）。

paragraphs.en: Beyond financial research. A broader direction is type-level rubric induction as a reusable paradigm for document evaluation. Academic papers, literature surveys ( Yifei et al., 2025 ) , legal documents and other expert-written texts could supply genre-specific requirements, with completeness traced to evidence and argument validity assessed separately. Adapting this paradigm beyond finance will require domain-specific corpora, applicability checks and validation of both layers.
paragraphs.zh: 超越金融研究。 一个更广泛的方向是类型级评分准则归纳，将其作为一种可复用的文档评估范式。 学术论文、文献综述（Yifei et al., 2025）、法律文件及其他专家撰写的文本可以提供特定文体的要求，其中完整性可追溯至证据，论证有效性则单独评估。 将该范式扩展到金融之外，将需要特定领域的语料库、适用性检查以及对两个层次的验证。

paragraphs.en: Mining versus task-generated rubrics. An LLM could instead generate a rubric for each task, including a structured rubric. Our distinction is not the presence of a hierarchy alone, but the basis for its analytical questions: model-generated expectations for one request versus analyses documented across expert reports on different objects. Mining preserves source-question records for auditing each abstraction, while the question-centred hierarchy connects detailed checks to those analyses. This is a design argument, not a head-to-head comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 挖掘式评分标准与任务生成式评分标准的对比。 另一种做法是由大语言模型为每个任务生成评分标准，包括结构化的评分标准。 我们的区别不在于是否单纯存在层级结构，而在于其分析性问题的依据：是针对单个请求由模型生成的预期，还是专家报告中对不同对象的跨报告分析所记录的内容。 挖掘式方法保留了源问题记录，便于审计每次抽象提炼，而以问题为中心的层级结构将细致的检查项与这些分析联系起来。 这是一项设计层面的论证，而非面对面的对比实验。

paragraphs.en: Developing validity evaluation. Question-specific checks, such as whether growth follows from stated inputs, require separate validation. Once both layers are validated, Pareto dominance compares agents no worse on either dimension and strictly better on at least one, otherwise retaining the trade-off. Future directions include crediting checkpoints only when cited passages have no established flaw, and propagating unsupported premises through question dependencies.
paragraphs.zh: 开展效度评估。 针对特定问题的检查（例如增长是否源自所述输入）需要单独进行验证。 一旦两层都通过验证，帕累托优势比较会将智能体判定为在任一维度上都不更差、且至少在一个维度上严格更优，否则保留其权衡关系。 未来的方向包括仅当被引用段落没有既定缺陷时才为检查点记分，以及将无依据的前提沿问题依赖关系传播。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. The first-author audit is not independent expert validation and does not establish task applicability or the fidelity of every Target. Source support measures recurrence, not importance; tier weights are a design choice. Source experiments restrict a frozen atlas rather than re-extract single-report or task-generated rubrics. We do not isolate the contribution of hierarchical organisation against a flat-checklist baseline. Perturbations test unrelated and duplicated text, not on-topic empty expansion. Rule effort and output format are not isolated by ablation. Shared repeat-run variance is a proxy that includes wording changes. Agents run once per task, so intervals exclude generation randomness; search has no date filter.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 第一作者的审核并非独立的专家验证，也不能确立任务的适用性或每个 Target 的保真度。 来源支持衡量的是复现度，而非重要性；层级权重是一种设计选择。 来源实验是对冻结的图集进行限制，而非重新提取单篇报告或任务生成的评分细则。 我们没有对照扁平清单基线来分离层级组织的贡献。 扰动测试针对的是无关文本和重复文本，而非切题的空洞扩展。 规则投入与输出格式未通过消融实验加以分离。 共享的重复运行方差是包含措辞变化在内的一种代理指标。 智能体在每个任务上仅运行一次，因此区间排除了生成随机性；检索没有日期过滤器。

paragraphs.en: Expert reports on different objects supply recurring analytical requirements, not merely reference answers. RubricAtlas organises these requirements by type and links checks to analytical questions, yielding profiles of completed and missing analyses in Web deep research reports. Reference-report selection experiments motivate cross-report aggregation; cross-judge evaluation and controlled deletions support evidence-linked completeness comparisons. A first-author audit adds a human check on sampled mappings and decisions. Argument validity remains separate: the tested generic rules require further validation before entering a combined score.
paragraphs.zh: 针对不同对象的专家报告提供了反复出现的分析需求，而不仅仅是参考答案。 RubricAtlas 按类型组织这些需求，并将检查项与分析问题关联，从而在 Web 深度研究报告中生成已完成与缺失分析的画像。 参考报告选择实验为跨报告聚合提供了依据；跨评审者评估与受控删除支持有证据关联的完整性比较。 第一作者审计对抽样映射与决策进行了人工核查。 论证有效性仍然单独处理：所测试的通用规则在纳入综合评分之前还需要进一步验证。

paragraphs.en: Repeat-run protocol. With a fixed seed, we sample ten research-question families without replacement, one task per family rotating across pool-size tertiles, and all ten agents (100 reports). Mean main-run T is 39.6, below the benchmark average; re-evaluation lowers scores by 1.8 points, with a shared agent shift. Perturbations use three agents on these ten tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 重复运行协议。 在固定随机种子下，我们无放回地抽取十个研究问题族，每个族一个任务，并在池规模三分位间轮转，同时使用全部十个智能体（100 份报告）。 主运行的 T 均值为 39.6，低于基准平均值；重新评估使分数下降 1.8 分，且存在共享的智能体偏移。 扰动实验在这十个任务上使用三个智能体。

paragraphs.en: Variance proxy. Dividing the SD of paired repeat-minus-main report scores by the square root of two gives a report-level proxy of 4.1 points. Dividing this by the square root of 98 gives 0.42 points for the mean over these tasks. These steps assume independent, equal-variance run errors and independent errors across tasks. Score-interval half-widths combine the task-bootstrap half-width and 1.96 times the mean proxy by summing their squares and taking the square root. Agent-gap intervals additionally scale the mean proxy by the square root of two, assuming independent agent errors. Ranks and first-place fractions use task resampling alone. Both judges share A’s proxy, which includes wording variation; B-specific, correlated and generation errors are not separately estimated.
paragraphs.zh: 方差代理值。 将配对的重复减主报告分数的标准差除以二的平方根，得到报告层面的代理值为 4.1 分。 将其除以 98 的平方根，得到这些任务均值的代理值为 0.42 分。 这些步骤假设运行误差相互独立且方差相等，并假设各任务之间的误差相互独立。 分数区间的半宽由任务自助法半宽与 1.96 乘以均值代理值组合而成，方法是将两者平方后求和再取平方根。 智能体差距区间额外将均值代理值乘以二的平方根，前提是假设智能体误差相互独立。 排名与第一名占比仅使用任务重采样。 两个评审共用 A 的代理值，其中包含措辞差异；B 特有误差、相关误差与生成误差则未单独估计。

paragraphs.en: Nugget evaluation. TREC nuggets define content for one input ( Voorhees, 2003 ; Mayfield et al., 2024 ; Pradeep et al., 2025 ) ; our questions abstract analyses across objects. Assessor agreement ( Lin and Demner-Fushman, 2006 ) and report support measure recurrence, but scoring uses tier weights (§ 3 ), not institution counts. A comparison can satisfy required metrics yet use inappropriate peers: its completeness and validity are distinct.
paragraphs.zh: 要点式评估。 TREC 要点为单个输入定义内容（Voorhees, 2003；Mayfield et al., 2024；Pradeep et al., 2025）；我们的问题则将分析抽象到多个对象之上。 评估者一致性（Lin and Demner-Fushman, 2006）与报告支持度衡量的是复现性，但评分使用层级权重（§ 3），而非机构数量。 一次比较可以满足要求的指标，却使用了不恰当的同类对象：其完整性与有效性是彼此独立的。

paragraphs.en: Restricting evaluation to questions supported by the task’s source report changes the task-level leader on 50% of tasks and the top-three set on 76%. Size-matched random subsets change the leader on 45% of tasks (5th–95th percentiles 38–52%). Task-level rankings are therefore sensitive to both tested reductions of the requirements, motivating our focus on aggregate agent comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 将评估范围限定于任务源报告所支持的问题，会使 50% 的任务的任务级榜首发生变化，76% 的任务的前三名集合发生变化。 大小匹配的随机子集会使 45% 的任务（第 5 至第 95 百分位为 38–52%）的榜首发生变化。 因此，任务级排名对这两种被测试的缩减要求方式都很敏感，这促使我们关注聚合的智能体比较。

paragraphs.en: Checkpoint sampling and materials. The 300 items were sampled with seed 20261023 from atlas checkpoints judged by both models. Quotas were 100 both-yes, 100 both-no, 50 A-yes/B-no and 50 A-no/B-yes. Each report–question contributed at most one item and each task at most six. Questions with no aligned passage under either judge were excluded. The author received the union of the passages aligned by both judges, not necessarily the same material either judge had evaluated. Disagreement can therefore reflect evidence selection as well as interpretation of a checkpoint.
paragraphs.zh: 检查点抽样与材料。 这 300 个条目是从两个模型都判定过的检查点中，以种子 20261023 抽样得到的。 配额为：两者均为是 100 条、两者均为否 100 条、A 为是/B 为否 50 条，以及 A 为否/B 为是 50 条。 每个报告—问题最多贡献一个条目，每个任务最多贡献六个。 在任一判定者下都没有对齐段落的提问被排除在外。 作者收到的是两个判定者所对齐段落的并集，未必是任一判定者曾评估过的同一材料。 因此，分歧既可能反映证据选择，也可能反映对检查点的解读。

The model judges agree on 200/300 items (66.7%) in this deliberately disagreement-enriched sample, rather than the full-corpus 85.4%.

paragraphs.en: Source-question mappings. The audit sampled 25 consensus and 25 differentiating questions, at most one per research type and six source mappings per question. Among 297 mappings, 231 were marked yes (77.8%), 45 partial (15.2%) and 21 no (7.1%). Partial mappings are reported separately: a source question may address only part of a broader canonical question. This audit examines question grouping, not every Target’s fidelity to source arguments or applicability to a task object.

paragraphs.en: Report preferences. The optional audit included 20 same-task report pairs stratified by judge-A score gaps below 3, from 3 to 8, and at least 8 points.
